items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.
Substantial experience using request tracking, inventory management software, library management software, or similar systems.
Experience working in a collaborative, team-based work environment.
Experience directing the work of others.

Interlibrary Loan, a unit within the User Services & Resource Sharing Department, advances and supports the University's research, teaching, and public service missions. Under the general supervision of the Interlibrary Loan Coordinator, this position: Performs daily ILL workflow functions, supervises Interlibrary Loan student staff, provides public service and patron education, works collaboratively to develop best practices, and participates on projects and library committees.
Staff members support the UCSC Principles of Community, which can be found here:
Understanding of the ways that racism, ableism, and sexism appear in work environments; interest in fostering an inclusive environment that supports a sense of belonging.
Able to give, receive, evaluate, and apply constructive criticism.
Ability to perform bibliographic verification using online tools.
Demonstrated skill in organizing, monitoring, and setting priorities for a heavy workload with multiple tasks and competing deadlines.
Superior communication skills to negotiate routine and difficult interactions.
Ability to continually assess workflow processes with an eye toward efficiency and best practices.
